extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, and scholars researching David Foster Wallace or Infinite Jest
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts evaluative and descriptive criteria used in discussing Infinite Jest — its form, style, themes, structure, and reception — useful for analyzing or modelling similar encyclopedic/postmodern novels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encyclopedic scope / display of knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Wallace's "encyclopedic display of knowledge" incorporates media theory, linguistics, film studies, sport, addiction, science, and issues of national identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The novel is classified as a postmodern encyclopedic novel; its scope and accumulation of specialized material are central to its identity and affect how readers approach and evaluate it (knowledge breadth is part of its aesthetic).

rubrics_metrics.name: Heavy use of endnotes
rubrics_metrics.description: Infinite Jest includes hundreds of extensive endnotes, some with footnotes of their own.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Endnotes function as a structural and narrative device: Wallace characterized their use as a method of disrupting the linearity of the text while maintaining some sense of narrative cohesion. The article notes 388 endnotes and discusses endnotes' role in pacing, digression, and reader experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unconventional, non-chronological narrative structure / interwoven narratives
rubrics_metrics.description: The novel has an unconventional narrative structure and several major interwoven narratives; it eschews chronological plot development and straightforward resolution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plot threads (e.g., ETA tennis students, Ennet House residents, Québécois radicals) are connected thematically rather than by linear chronology. This fragmentation supports multiple readings and complicates expectations of standard plot resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternating points of view and narration techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: The novel's narration mostly alternates between third-person limited and omniscient points of view, but also includes several first-person accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: POV shifts contribute to the encyclopedic and polyphonic texture; evaluate how perspective changes affect character intimacy, irony, and the reader's ability to piece together events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length, detail, and digressive density
rubrics_metrics.description: Infinite Jest is famous for its length (1,079 pages), detail, and digressions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Size and complexity are central aesthetic features and points of critical contention: some reviewers celebrate the ambition and inventiveness, while others criticize it as bloated or forbidding. Consider how length and digression serve thematic and formal aims versus creating barriers to accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fractal/experimental structural modeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Wallace said the plotting and notes had a fractal structure modeled after the Sierpiński gasket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book's structure is explicitly experimental: recursive, self-similar patterns are intended to organize narrative material across main text and notes. This formal claim can be used as a criterion when judging coherence and intentional design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Central themes (addiction, worship, recovery, family, mental health)
rubrics_metrics.description: The novel touches on many topics including addiction (to drugs, sex, and fame), withdrawal, recovery, twelve-step programs, death, family relationships, absent or dead parents, mental health, suicide, sadness, entertainment, film theory, and national identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addiction and forms of devotion/worship tie together disparate plotlines; evaluation should attend to how effectively thematic consistency is maintained across diverse narrative strands and subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone: balance of humor and melancholy
rubrics_metrics.description: The book is often humorous yet explores melancholy deeply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The interplay of comic elements with serious, melancholic explorations of suffering and addiction is a defining stylistic feature; analyses should consider how humor functions (e.g., satirical, ironic, dark) alongside empathetic or melancholic registers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intertextuality and explicit literary allusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Infinite Jest draws explicitly or allusively on many previous works of literature (e.g., Hamlet, the Odyssey, The Brothers Karamazov, Ulysses).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allusive mapping (characters/plot to canonical works) is used to deepen meaning and structure; evaluate the success and necessity of these correspondences and their interpretive payoff for readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of media/film as diegetic and metaphorical device (the Entertainment)
rubrics_metrics.description: A film within the novel, Infinite Jest (the "Entertainment"), is so compelling that its viewers lose all interest in anything else, and thus eventually die.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The self-contained media object operates as central plot engine and metaphor for entertainment, addiction, and consumption. Assess how effectively the diegetic film embodies and advances thematic concerns (and how it motivates plot actions like espionage/terrorism).

rubrics_metrics.name: Worldbuilding and socio-political satire
rubrics_metrics.description: The future setting includes a unified North American superstate (Organization of North American Nations, O.N.A.N.), corporate naming rights for calendar years, and geopolitically induced landscapes like the 'Great Concavity' hazardous waste dump.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Speculative political-economic details and satirical elements (corporate naming, environmental dispossession) form part of the book's social critique; evaluate plausibility, satirical clarity, and how setting amplifies themes such as consumerism and national identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterization and psychological focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal drama (notably Hal Incandenza's struggles) and detailed backstories (e.g., Don Gately, Joelle van Dyne) provide psychological depth and drive much of the novel's emotional weight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Character complexity, interiority, and arcs are key to the novel's affective work; assess whether characters are rendered with empathy and consistency and how their psychologies connect to larger themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal/genre positioning (postmodern, metamodernist, hysterical realism)
rubrics_metrics.description: The novel has been called postmodern, metamodernist, and hysterical realist; critics note Pynchonesque elements and encyclopedic ambition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Genre labels are part of critical evaluation: consider which register(s) the work occupies and how it conforms to or subverts the conventions of those movements (e.g., irony vs. sincerity debates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical reception and cultural impact as evaluative metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical response ranged from calling it a masterpiece and central American novel of a generation to labeling it bloated or 'just awful'; it was heavily marketed and became the center of 'Wallace Studies'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reception (contemporary reviews, retrospective reassessments), sales, publicity strategies, and ensuing scholarship are relevant measures when judging the novel's significance and influence beyond purely textual qualities.
